release.content: publet-core 0.1.4 was released on 2026-10-28 from commit 48792bdcf53d98f0e3582c889c6f170baedf98f4 with these changes.

rows: TESTING.md is now generated by `pubkit doc-coverage` (pubkit 0.6.0) instead of tools/doc-coverage.py; only its header line changed
Update other crates the supply-chain audits cover
SUPPLY-CHAIN.md names pubunit among the organisations whose audits are imported, since the workspace now imports pubunit's

ed25519-dalek 3.0.0 and sha2 0.11 replace ed25519-dalek 2 and sha2 0.10, so block-buffer 0.10.4 (GHSA-qwgh-2vcv-g2f7) is no longer in publet-core's dependency tree; the public API, which takes and returns bytes, is unchanged, as are the signatures and identifiers it produces, and the MSRV stays 1.85

Documentation: SECURITY.md says cargo deny, cargo vet and OSV-Scanner also run every night (it said advisory checks ran only when code changed), and names pubunit among the imported audit sets; verify's # Errors lists each error and when it is returned; its example shows where its seed comes from; the cid row of Related crates names the version checked (0.11.3)
